mechanism_narrative: Residential construction starts above 700 thousand units indicate strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with robust economic growth and positive equity market sentiment, leading to S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 700.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates an exceptionally accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a robust economic expansion cycle, which drives positive equity market returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS and RSAFS increasing > 0.1% MoM fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 235), a federal funds rate below 0.2% signals aggressive monetary easing, which reduces real interest rates and stimulates equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 235 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 95 (index 2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing output, which correlates with strong corporate earnings growth and positive equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO > 95.

mechanism_narrative: Employment levels above 133,000 thousand persons indicate a tight labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 133000.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates below 8.0% indicate a strengthening labor market, which correlates with higher consumer confidence and increased corporate investment, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST > 700) and consumer spending (RSAFS > 400000) indicates robust household demand, which drives positive equity market returns as economic growth accelerates.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 700 and RSAFS > 400000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.
